Description: Legacy Software Restriction Policy path rules for location-based .lnk defense-in-depth
MicrosoftStatus: SRP is deprecated beginning with Windows 10 1803; Microsoft recommends WDAC or AppLocker. This framework verifies registry configuration only, not runtime enforcement.
Status: Microsoft advisory ADV25258226; these path rules are supplemental and are not claimed as a complete CVE mitigation

SRPConfiguration.Description: Unrestricted - Allow all programs except explicitly blocked

PathRules.Name: Block LNK from Outlook Temp
PathRules.Description: Legacy SRP path rule intended to restrict .lnk launch from the current user's Temp tree, including common attachment staging locations.
PathRules.Impact: Prevents execution of .lnk files from email attachments. Legitimate shortcuts from Start Menu/Desktop/Taskbar still work (different paths).

PathRules.Name: Block LNK from Downloads
PathRules.Description: Legacy SRP path rule intended to restrict .lnk launch from the current user's Downloads folder.
PathRules.Impact: Prevents execution of .lnk files downloaded from internet. Move .lnk to another location to execute if needed.

Testing.ExpectedResult: Execution blocked with 'This program is blocked by group policy' message
Testing.ExpectedResult2: Execution allowed (Desktop not in blocked path list)
